jobs.employer_name: KiTA An der Bucerius Law School e.V
jobs.description: Create your own happiness!Are you a passionate early childhood educator (m/f/d)? Do you put your heart and soul into your work, but haven’t been satisfied with your working conditions so far?Come check us out—maybe you’ll like what you find here?What you can look forward to…The basics: pay, vacation time, and working hours.We are actually offering a fixed-term full-time position. The full-time workweek is 38 hours. Initially, the contract would be fixed-term, but an extension is possible.Pay is based on the TVöD SuE collective bargaining agreement and depends on your professional experience and qualifications. A 13th month’s salary (at 100%, instead of 85%) is paid after one year of service. We have between 32 and 34 days of vacation per year. Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve are paid holidays. The cost of an HVV/Deutschlandticket is fully covered, and if interested, you can participate in a fitness program.The Position: Responsibilities and Working Conditions.We are looking for at least one new early childhood educator with a perfect command of the English language.Your responsibilities include the attentive care, nurturing, and support of the children (age 1-6) entrusted to us in line with our educational approach, working closely with the children, parents, and the entire team. In your daily work, you would speak mainly English.We would appreciate at least some experience in this field and a preference for this age group would be advantageous.Our working conditions are truly worth highlighting: In the elementary section, four colleagues together care for 35 children; in the nursery section, four additional colleagues care for 16 children. In addition, we employ a housekeeping staff member with educational qualifications and, in the future, a substitute.We hold weekly team meetings to discuss weekly schedules, activities, and specific situations, as well as to plan parent-teacher conferences and developmental meetings. Our sponsoring organization places great emphasis on providing good working conditions.The Team: One for all, all for one!Some of us have been working together successfully and happily for over ten years. It goes without saying that we support one another and treat each other with care. Our sense of humor and our willingness to stand up for one another carry us through the sometimes hectic daily routine of the daycare center.On concept days, we discuss educational topics, engage in professional development, and reflect on our work. Regular weekly team meetings, preparation time, and supervision are just as much a part of our routine as extended get-togethers during company outings and Christmas parties.Has this piqued your curiosity? Then you should definitely keep reading…Important: Empathy, joy, and qualifications.To ensure we comply with legal requirements, it is very important that our new team member holds a completed, state-recognized qualification as an early childhood educator (m/f/d), a degree in early childhood education or early childhood development, or a degree as a social pedagogue (m/f/d). It would be helpful if you have a good understanding of the English language, as we are a bilingual facility.We are looking for an empathetic person with a Reggio Emilia approach (including a child-centered perspective) and someone who genuinely enjoys working with children, because we want you to look forward to coming to work.Feel free to get to know us!The Daycare Center: Location. Concept. Focus Areas.The daycare center is located in the heart of Planten un Blomen and is surrounded by plenty of greenery. It is easily accessible by public transportation from all parts of Hamburg (Gänsemarkt, Dammtor, Stephansplatz).There are two groups, a nursery group and an elementary group, in which 42-48 children are currently cared for by nine early childhood educators. Our facilities allow us to organize various projects and activities in workshops and specialized rooms.The foundation of our concept is the Reggio approach. Above all, it reflects our attitude toward others and how we wish to approach life’s changes. Our daycare is a place for self-directed, holistic learning, and we foster a respectful approach not only toward the children entrusted to us, but toward all people.We integrate key areas such as yoga, woodworking, art studio work, language development, music, relaxation and movement, and preschool preparation into our daily routine. Do you have a particular focus? A passion? Let’s find out together if we can integrate this into our daily routine as well…Start up initiative: Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.Our small operator, “Kindertagesstätte an der Bucerius Law School e.V.”, was founded in 2008 and is a member of the Paritätischer Wohlfahrtsverband Hamburg. Loki Schmidt was the founding patron of our daycare center.Our organization consists of a single facility. This means that decisions can be made and implemented quickly, easily, and on an individual basis. Here, people are still allowed to be people; they are heard and are not just a personnel number.As a member of the Bucerius family and an initiative of the ZEIT STIFTUNG BUCERIUS, our work makes an important contribution to promoting an open, democratic society.The Future: Do you think we’re a good fit for you?Then please send us your application materials. We would love to get to know you.If you’re interested, feel free to check out our website (https://www.law-school.de/services/kita (https://www.law-school.de/services/kita) ) or our Instagram account (kita.buceriuslaw).Thank you for your attention, and we hope to see you soon!

Contribute to advanced analog development for cutting-edge electric power testing systems trusted worldwide! This job will provide you with an opportunity to further your career alongside some of the best and most passionate technology experts from around the world in a leading company within the test, measurement and data analytics industry. You will be a strong contributor, collaborating closely with colleagues from various business functions.In this medior/senior position, you’ll play a key role in developing high‑performance circuits that power precision measurement technologies used by leading companies worldwide. Your expertise will help drive innovation and ensure our products continue to set the standard for accuracy and reliability.Primary responsibilitiesYou will, as a Analog Hardware Engineer (m/w/d) be responsible for developing and sustaining our state-of-the-art electric power testing DAQ solutions at our site in Darmstadt.Your development activities- Develop and maintain analog designs for different data acquisition systems.- Research new analog designs with the help of simulation (e.g. LTSpice).- Schematics design and layout of PCBs for analog systems.- Set and verify specifications for data acquisition products.- Define tests for production to (automatically) validate analog hardware.- Keep in contact with (major) manufacturers to monitor trends in analog product development.- Assist in the CE certification process and support during external certification, both for EMC as well as low voltage safety.Professional qualifications- Min 5 – 10 years’ experience in analog design.- Excellent understanding of analog components and design principles, for example circuits including Op-Amps, analog filters, A/D converters, etc.- A good knowledge of PCB design’s influence on noise, crosstalk etc. Optimum component placement and routing.- Grounding and EMC design- Knowledge of design-to-cost- Experience in circuit design using Altium Designer- Usage of Spice-simulation during the design phase- Good communication skills with other involved parties such as: ECAD, firmware, test department, QA, production, etc.Personal skills- Good communication skills in English, both verbally and in writing.- Good interpersonal skills- Team player, but also able to solve problems individually.- Hands on, able to or used to work from prototype to production phase.- Accurate, practical and result driven personality.- Experience in working in international located development team is a plus.We OfferFreedom with responsibility is the framework for HBK’s employees. This allows for a good balance between work and family life and for constant development of professional and personal skills in an international and enjoyable working environment.One company – HBKOn 1 January 2019, Brüel & Kjær and HBM merged their activities into a new company called HBK (Hottinger Brüel & Kjær). With more than 3,500 employees worldwide and production facilities in Denmark, Germany, the UK, the USA, China and Portugal and presence in 80 countries, HBK is a leading player in the test and measurement area. For further info please visit www.hbkworld.com.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description: We are looking for an experienced Electrical Supervisor to support offshore HVDC converter platform activities, covering maintenance, troubleshooting, commissioning, and site coordination. The role combines technical oversight, contractor management, electrical safety leadership, and interface coordination within a complex offshore energy environment. Candidates with HVDC, offshore wind, or high-voltage infrastructure experience are highly preferred.Your Tasks- Coordinate and supervise maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and commissioning activities on offshore HVDC converter platforms.- Manage OEMs, contractors, and service providers while ensuring efficient execution of offshore works.- Ensure compliance with HSE requirements, Permit-to-Work systems, LOTO procedures, and electrical safety standards.- Monitor work progress, technical quality, schedule adherence, and compliance with project requirements.- Coordinate interfaces between operations, engineering, commissioning, HSE teams, and contractors.- Track technical defects, non-conformities, and outstanding works while preparing site reports and escalating critical issues.- Assume VEFK (Responsible Electrical Person) duties where formally appointed.Your qualifications- Technician, Master Craftsman, or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related discipline.- Experience within offshore wind, HVDC/HGÜ systems, substations, high-voltage installations, or energy infrastructure projects.- Strong knowledge of HV/MV equipment, electrical isolation procedures, LOTO, and Permit-to-Work systems.- Experience in site supervision, contractor coordination, maintenance, and/or commissioning activities.- VEFK qualification or solid experience within the German electrical safety framework is highly desirable.- Good understanding of HVDC converter systems and reactive power compensation systems is an advantage.- Strong HSE mindset, proactive approach, and ability to work independently.- Good English skills; German language skills are considered beneficial.- Willingness to work offshore, travel regularly, and participate in standby rotations.- Offshore medical fitness and offshore safety certification (or willingness to obtain them).

We are seeking an experienced Grid Connection Engineer to support offshore wind projects with a strong focus on grid compliance, power system studies, and technical integration. The role requires hands-on experience with grid connection engineering, stakeholder management, and compliance verification according to German grid codes and TSO requirements. Previous experience with offshore wind developers is considered a key advantage.Your Tasks- Review and validate power system models using DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD, or similar simulation tools.- Manage and oversee subcontractors performing grid connection, conformity, and design studies.- Prepare and review ONAR, NAR, and other grid compliance studies and supporting documentation.- Assess turbine, converter, PPC, and network models to ensure compliance with project and operational requirements.- Identify compliance gaps, perform technical investigations, and develop corrective solutions through calculations and simulations.- Define and verify interfaces between TSO, PPC, SCADA systems, and other project stakeholders while ensuring alignment with VDE-AR-N 4131 and grid connection requirements.Your qualifications- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.- Proven experience in offshore wind projects, ideally on the developer side.- Strong expertise in grid compliance studies, including ONAR, NAR, VDE-AR-N 4131, and TSO requirements.- Advanced knowledge of DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD, or comparable power system simulation software.- Solid understanding of PPC, SCADA systems, plant control concepts, and grid connection interfaces.- Excellent stakeholder and interface management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple technical parties effectively.- Fluency in english is required

We are looking for an experienced HVDC Cable Engineer to support two major transmission infrastructure projects. jobs.occupation: Director Client Success (Leiter/in - Key Account Management)
jobs.employer_name: Visa Europe Management Services German Branch Ltd.
jobs.description: About UsVisa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world.  Progress starts with you.Job DescriptionThe Client Success Director is a key leadership role with responsibility for both managing a portfolio of strategic client accounts and leading a team that delivers high-quality post-sale service and operational support. In this position, you will act as a play maker who balances direct client management with active team leadership.You are accountable for the overall client experience. This includes working closely with senior client stakeholders to understand their business needs and ensure they receive ongoing value from our solutions. The role involves driving product adoption, supporting client growth and serving as the main advocate for client interests across different functions and regions.You will also lead your team by setting clear direction and providing continuous support. You will foster a collaborative and high-performance culture and encourage professional growth. You will ensure that your team’s work aligns with Client Success strategies and help them navigate complex challenges in support of our clients.This role provides an opportunity to contribute to our Client Success transformation. You will work with cross-functional partners to deliver strong outcomes for clients and support the ongoing development of your team. The Director Client Success reports to the Head of Client Services Central Europe and Eurozone Operations and is based in Frankfurt.Responsibilities include:- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Client Success team. Set clear goals and expectations, provide regular feedback, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and growth-oriented culture- Align your team’s work with the overall Client Success strategy. Inspire team members to embrace change, adopt best practices, and continuously grow their skills and expertise- Promote knowledge sharing and collaboration within your team and across the wider Client Success organization- Oversee your team’s client portfolios to ensure consistent, high-quality post-sale service and operational support- Directly manage a portfolio of strategic client accounts. Build and sustain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders by acting as a proactive advisor and advocate- Serve as the primary point of contact for your own clients, understanding their business strategies, operational goals, and priorities. Ensure their needs are met and that they realize ongoing value from Visa solutions- Develop, execute, and monitor Client Success Plans for your own clients, in alignment with the Account Team. Track key outcomes including product adoption, performance, and satisfaction- Oversee and support the implementation of new Visa products for both your own clients and those managed by your team. Coordinate with key client and Visa stakeholders to expedite readiness activities, maximize adoption, and deliver value—often across multiple geographies- Guide your team in understanding client systems landscapes, integration points, and critical opportunities and challenges. Support them in identifying and addressing client needs that align with business growth- Drive and deliver initiatives that improve client adoption of Visa products and promote the use of self-service tools. Monitor and report on health metrics for your own clients and those managed by your team.- Serve as a thought leader on market trends, Visa solutions, and new technologies. Help both your team and your clients stay informed and ahead of industry developments.- Foster strong cross-functional relationships with Client Services and other internal teams. Lead efforts to resolve complex client issues and optimize performance through effective collaboration.- Share knowledge and insights regularly with colleagues across Client Success, Sales, Product, and other functions both for your own clients and more broadly within the market or region.- Oversee and contribute to the development and delivery of client education and training, including webinars and communications on new Visa rules and business enhancements.- Lead or participate in operational reviews with clients and internal stakeholders, including at an international level for global clients.- Act as the escalation point for major issues and incidents for your own clients and those managed by your team. The Max Planck Society is Germany's premier research organization. The 86 Max Planck Institutes conduct research at highest levels, in the service of the general public, in the natural sciences, life sciences, social sciences, and the humanities.The Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter (MPSD) is located at the Science Campus Hamburg-Bahrenfeld and investigates dynamical phenomena within matter down to the elementary timescales of atomic and electronic motions, the femtosecond or attosecond timescale. The focus is on the use of short wavelength ultrafast probes, such as X-rays or electron pulses, which are capable of measuring atomic and electronic structures in matter of all kinds.The MPSD currently consists of five scientific departments focusing on solid state physics and theoretical methods in these fields. The MPSD is a partner in the Center for Free-Electron Laser Science (CFEL), collaborating with the Deutsches Elektronen Synchrotron (DESY), European XFEL (EuXFEL) and the University of Hamburg in the development of science based on the X-ray Free Electron Lasers (XFELs).To strengthen our support for experimental research, the MPSD is seeking a highly motivatedElectronics Engineer (m/f/d)Your positionAs an Electronics Engineer, you will support cutting-edge experimental physics research by developing reliable, high-performance electronic systems in close collaboration with scientists, engineers and technical staff.- Develop, design and implement analogue and digital electronic systems for experimental physics applications.- Translate scientific and technical requirements into robust electronic concepts, circuits and complete devices.- Design, assemble, commission and test printed circuit boards (PCBs) and electronic instruments, from initial concept through prototyping to deployment in the laboratory.- Diagnose, troubleshoot and optimise existing electronic systems and measurement equipment.- Develop firmware for microcontrollers and support the integration of hardware, firmware and software components.- Work closely with researchers and engineers to provide practical, user-oriented technical solutions for a broad range of experimental setups.- Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including circuit diagrams, PCB layouts, assembly instructions and test procedures.- As the role involves hands-on development, assembly, testing and support of laboratory equipment, regular on-site presence is an essential part of the position.Your background and skills- A university degree (Master’s degree or Diplom) in electrical engineering, electronics or a closely related field.- Sound practical experience in the development of analogue and digital electronic systems, including circuit design, PCB layout and the assembly, commissioning and testing of electronic devices.- Proficiency in common ECAD tools for schematic capture and PCB design, ideally including KiCad or Autodesk EAGLE, as well as familiarity with circuit-simulation tools.- Knowledge of firmware development for microcontrollers, ideally using C/C++. Experience in developing user software for the control, operation and monitoring of electronic devices is also desirable.- Experience with FPGA development and VHDL is an advantage. Familiarity with CAD systems for mechanical design is also desirable.- A strong understanding of the requirements and working practices of a diverse scientific and technical environment, combined with intercultural competence and effective communication skills.- Excellent written and spoken German and English skills.- Experience in laboratory electronics, measurement technology, scientific instrumentation or experimental physics is desirable.Our offer- A varied and responsible position in an international and interdisciplinary scientific environment, with the opportunity to contribute directly to innovative experimental research.- Close collaboration with scientists, engineers and technical staff on challenging and diverse technical projects.- A family-friendly working environment with flexible working arrangements, in line with the practical requirements of laboratory-based work.- Opportunities for professional development and further training.- Attractive remuneration and social benefits in accordance with the applicable public-sector collective agreement, depending on qualifications and professional experience.- An initial contract for two years, with the possibility of permanent employment thereafter.- The opportunity to work in a collaborative, inclusive and forward-looking research environment.- A subsidy for the Profiticket as a Germany ticketYour applicationThe Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all background.The Max-Planck Society is committed to increasing the number of individuals with disabilities in its workforce and therefore encourages applications from such qualified individuals.To apply please complete the online application form and attach you English CV and motivation letter as well as all relevant certificates latest 15th November, 2026.If you have any questions, please feel free to contact contact Dr. Friedjof Tellkamp by email at friedjof.tellkamp@mpsd.mpg.de (https://mailto:friedjof.tellkamp@mpsd.mpg.de) or Dr. Lars Tiemann at lars.tiemann@mpsd.mpg.de (lars.tiemann@mpsd.mpg.de) .Detailed information about the Max Planck Institute for the Structure and Dynamics of Matter and the online application portal can be found on our website at: https://www.mpsd.mpg.de/karriere/jobs (https://www.mpsd.mpg.de/karriere/jobs)We look forward to your application.
